create_metrics_handler: extend TodMetricsHandler to create a custom metrics handler for tracking conversation events
register_metrics_handler: register a custom metrics handler class with the METRICS_HANDLER_CLASSES_TEST_REGISTRY decorator
calculate_goals_hit: use goals_hit_helper to check if API calls meet conversation goals and return success metrics
track_api_call_success: use AllGoalApiCallSuccessMetricsHandler to calculate synthetic task success and API call attempt metrics
track_user_done_token: use UserGeneratedDoneMetricHandler to track when users generate the DONE token and count conversation rounds
